mapper.select: SELECT * FROM afv_canvas_text_job WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO afv_canvas_text_job(id, node_run_id, run_id, project_id, model_id, model_limit, input_json, deadline_at, next_run_at, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{nodeRunId}, #{runId}, #{projectId}, #{modelId}, #{modelLimit}, #{input}, LEAST(#{deadline}, TIMESTAMPADD(HOUR, 1, UTC_TIMESTAMP(6))), UTC_TIMESTAMP(6), UTC_TIMESTAMP(6), UTC_TIMESTAMP(6))
mapper.select: SELECT j.id FROM afv_canvas_text_job j LEFT JOIN afv_ai_model m ON m.id = j.model_id WHERE ((j.status = 'READY' AND j.next_run_at <= UTC_TIMESTAMP(6)) OR (j.status = 'RUNNING' AND j.lease_until <= UTC_TIMESTAMP(6))) AND (j.permit_held = TRUE OR j.cancel_requested = TRUE OR j.request_started_at IS NOT NULL OR m.id IS NULL OR m.deleted = TRUE OR m.status <> 1 OR m.max_concurrency < 1 OR (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM afv_canvas_text_job busy WHERE busy.model_id = j.model_id AND busy.permit_held = TRUE) + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM afv_agent_model_request busy WHERE busy.model_id = j.model_id AND busy.permit_held = TRUE) < LEAST(j.model_limit, m.max_concurrency)) ORDER BY j.next_run_at, j.id LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
mapper.update: UPDATE afv_canvas_text_job SET status = 'RUNNING', owner_instance_id = #{owner}, owner_epoch = owner_epoch + 1, lease_until = TIMESTAMPADD(SECOND, 90, UTC_TIMESTAMP(6)), permit_held = TRUE WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM afv_canvas_text_job WHERE id = #{id} AND owner_instance_id = #{owner} AND owner_epoch = #{epoch} AND status = 'RUNNING' AND lease_until > UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE afv_canvas_text_job SET lease_until = TIMESTAMPADD(SECOND, 90, UTC_TIMESTAMP(6)) WHERE id = #{id} AND owner_instance_id = #{owner} AND owner_epoch = #{epoch} AND status = 'RUNNING' AND lease_until > UTC_TIMESTAMP(6)

UPDATE afv_canvas_text_job SET request_started_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(6), request_owner_instance_id = #{owner}, request_owner_epoch = #{epoch}, phase = '模型正在生成文本', revision = revision + 1, updated_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE id = #{id} AND request_started_at IS NULL

UPDATE afv_canvas_text_job SET status = #{status}, phase = #{phase}, error_msg = #{error}, permit_held = #{permit}, owner_instance_id = NULL, lease_until = NULL, revision = revision + 1, updated_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE afv_canvas_text_job SET cancel_requested = TRUE, next_run_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE id = #{id}

UPDATE afv_canvas_text_job SET status = 'READY', next_run_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(6), error_msg = NULL, result_accepted = TRUE, phase = '恢复已接收的结果', revision = revision + 1, updated_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE id = #{id}
